identity.description: Target is the user. Target wears black and begins on bottom near center frame around 0:10. analysis_context.note: Apply the established jiu-jitsu analysis protocol: identity-first tracking, dense visual checks around exchanges, observable fact separated from inference, specific named techniques only when visually supported, follow sequences from entry through endpoint, and account for training intent, effort asymmetry, deliberate concession of first-line defenses, and positional continuity.
